title: Spatial transcriptomic brain imaging in a mouse dementia model
author: Lee, Eun Ji
license_note: Zenodo record metadata license field: cc-by-4.0

steps.title: Embed and section brain tissue
steps.instruction: Prepare mouse brain hemispheres in frozen blocks using OCT compound (Sakura) and cryosection them at 10 µm thickness in coronal and sagittal orientations.

steps.title: Fix and stain sections
steps.instruction: Methanol‑fix the brain sections, then stain with hematoxylin and eosin (H&E).

steps.title: Image stained sections
steps.instruction: Capture images of the H&E‑stained sections on a TissueFAXS PLUS system (TissueGenostics).

steps.title: Create whole‑brain composite image
steps.instruction: Merge the individual section images into a single picture of the whole brain using TissueFAXS imaging software.

steps.title: Permeabilize and generate cDNA libraries
steps.instruction: Place the sections on Visium Spatial Tissue Optimization slides (10X Genomics) and permeabilize for 12 minutes; then follow the 10X Visium Spatial Gene Expression protocol to synthesize cDNA and construct libraries.

steps.title: QC PCR‑enriched fragments
steps.instruction: Assess the size distribution of the PCR‑enriched library fragments with a high‑sensitivity DNA assay on an Agilent Technologies 2100 Bioanalyzer.

steps.title: Sequence libraries on HiSeqXten
steps.instruction: Sequence the libraries on an Illumina HiSeqXten using the following read configuration: Read 1 = 28 bp (spatial barcode + UMI), i7 index = 10 bp, i5 index = 10 bp, Read 2 = 90 bp (RNA read).

steps.title: Convert BCL to FASTQ
steps.instruction: Convert Illumina base‑call (BCL) files to FASTQ format for each sample with the ‘mkfastq’ command.

steps.title: Run Space Ranger count pipeline
steps.instruction: Analyze the Visium spatial expression libraries using the ‘count’ command of Space Ranger v1.1.0 (10X Genomics).

steps.title: Align tissue image to spots
steps.instruction: Perform image alignment to predefined spots by using the fiducial alignment grid of the tissue image to set orientation and position.

steps.title: Align reads to mouse genome
steps.instruction: Align sequencing reads to the mm10 reference genome (mm10‑2020‑A) with STAR aligner version 2.5.1b.

steps.title: Generate gene expression matrix
steps.instruction: Profile gene expression for each spot using the unique molecular identifier (UMI) and 10X barcode information.

steps.title: Package Space Ranger output
steps.instruction: Compress the Space Ranger output directory into ‘ST_dataset.tgz’, a GZIP archive containing the Visium spatial transcriptomics results.
